exposure: absence of partograph monitoring during labor
cohort: The study included 412 women (103 cases with stillbirths and 309 controls without) who gave birth in hospitals of North Wollo Zone, Northeast Ethiopia.
finding: Premature rupture of membranes, induced labor, prolonged labor, absence of partograph monitoring, preterm birth, post-term birth, and carrying a female fetus were all significantly associated with an increased risk of stillbirth.
mod_finding: Induced labor was significantly associated with an increased risk of stillbirth (AOR = 2.24, 95% CI: 1.24-4.07).
